entries.sense_en: to an excessive degree; far more than is normal or reasonable

synonyms.nuance: Most common everyday word; simply 'too much', often critical.
Formal; means more than is justified, often used with worry or influence.

entries.sense_en: to feel and show great joy, especially because of a success

synonyms.nuance: Warmer and broader; joy at any good event, not always pride in one's own success.
Negative: happy about your own success or someone else's failure in an unpleasant way.

entries.sense_en: to work out a confusing problem by separating its parts

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word, used for knots and for messy situations alike.
Pulling threads apart one by one; often used for mysteries and plots.

entries.sense_en: a confusing puzzle or riddle that is hard to answer

synonyms.nuance: A puzzle in question form with a clever answer, like in a game.
Most general; anything that must be figured out, including toys and games.
A hard choice between two bad options, not a question with an answer.

entries.sense_en: the ability to see and judge things quickly and accurately

synonyms.nuance: A deep understanding of a person or problem; less tied to practical skill.
Sharp practical judgment, often about money or people, with a hint of cunning.
Noticing small details in people and situations.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 둘째 음절(어큐먼)이 전통적이지만 첫 음절(애큐먼)에 두기도 한다. 흔히 business acumen(사업 감각)으로 쓰인다.

entries.sense_en: above all others of its kind; in the truest or highest sense of the word

synonyms.nuance: Adjective for the most typical example of a kind.
Plain everyday phrase; less literary and no French flavor.

entries.tip_ko: 프랑스어 표현으로 '파르 엑설란스'에 가깝게 읽는다. 보통 명사 뒤에 놓지만(a detective par excellence), 여기서는 '그것이야말로 진짜 분석이라는 듯이'라는 부사적 쓰임이다.

entries.sense_en: without a plan or order; as things come to mind

synonyms.nuance: Suggests carelessness and lack of any system.
Neutral; chosen by chance, not necessarily careless.

entries.sense_en: silly, unserious behaviour or things that lack real value

synonyms.nuance: Childish, harmless foolishness; softer than frivolity.
Something of small importance, without the idea of playfulness.

entries.sense_en: a failure to pay attention; a slip made by not noticing something

synonyms.nuance: Something you failed to notice or include; the normal modern word.
General lack of care, not one specific slip.

entries.sense_en: to lead someone into a mistake by tempting or tricking them

synonyms.nuance: Attract with bait toward a trap; the closest sense here.
Tempt with something pleasant; less sense of deceit.
Cause a wrong belief, but without any temptation.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서는 '유혹해 성관계를 갖다'가 아니라 '속여 실수하게 만들다'는 뜻이다.

entries.sense_en: to deliberately avoid or keep away from something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; can be accidental or deliberate.
Stronger; to reject someone or something firmly, often socially.
To do without something that you could have.

entries.tip_ko: 발음은 '에스추'. 격식체·문어체 단어다.

entries.sense_en: an annoyed, embarrassed feeling after a failure or disappointment

synonyms.nuance: Mild irritation; lacks the embarrassment of failure.
Stronger; deep shame or humiliation.
Sadness that hopes failed; not necessarily any embarrassment.

entries.tip_ko: '샤그린'처럼 끝 음절에 강세가 온다.

entries.sense_en: a pretend move meant to make an opponent think something false

synonyms.nuance: Pretending to hold a strong hand, especially in cards; the closest card-game word.
A clever trick of any kind, not only a move in a game.

entries.tip_ko: faint(희미한; 기절하다)와 발음이 같다. 철자에 주의.

entries.sense_en: a nervous fear about something that is about to happen

synonyms.nuance: Long-lasting worry, not tied to one coming moment.
Uneasy expectation of something bad; more formal and calmer.
Stronger; heavy fear of something you know is coming.

entries.sense_en: the whole amount; everything added together

synonyms.nuance: Simpler; the entire thing.
Plain number or amount after adding up.

entries.sense_en: to mix up two different things so that they seem the same

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word for mixing up; 'confound' is more formal and literary.
Take one thing for another, usually with 'for'.
Formal; merge two ideas into one.

entries.tip_ko: '놀라게 하다, 당황시키다'의 뜻으로도 쓰이지만 여기서는 '혼동하다'.

entries.sense_en: unlucky and unwelcome; going badly

synonyms.nuance: Most common word for bad luck.
Describes conditions that work against you.

entries.sense_en: property or money inherited from one's father or family

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; anything left to you when someone dies.
Can be money, but also reputation or influence left behind.

entries.sense_en: honest, open speech without hiding anything

synonyms.nuance: Direct speech, even if it is a bit blunt.
Willingness to share; gentler and more general.

entries.tip_ko: candy(사탕)와 헷갈리지 말 것. 영국식 철자는 candour.

entries.sense_en: to set a feeling or interest on fire; to excite strongly

synonyms.nuance: Suggests stirring a strong, often angry, emotion.
Sudden start of a feeling or fire; common in modern writing.
Fills someone with the wish to act; positive.

entries.sense_en: to be shaky and about to fall down (of a building)

synonyms.nuance: Move unsteadily from side to side, without necessarily falling.
Balance unsteadily on the edge of falling.
Break into pieces slowly with age.

entries.sense_en: to let yourself be fully controlled by something

synonyms.nuance: Stronger; suggests losing a struggle.
Enjoy something freely, often too much.

entries.sense_en: in the habit of doing something (was wont to = used to)

synonyms.nuance: Used to something through repetition; usual with 'to'.
Everyday way to say a past habit.

entries.tip_ko: won't(~하지 않을 것이다)와 다르다. be wont to 형태로 쓰인다.

entries.sense_en: in a childishly bad-tempered, complaining way

synonyms.nuance: Almost the same; irritable over small things.
Silent, moody displeasure rather than complaint.
General annoyance; not necessarily childish.

entries.sense_en: a main street or road used by many people

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday term.
A wide, often tree-lined street in a city.
A major road between towns, made for fast traffic.

entries.tip_ko: 발음은 '써로우페어'. thorough와 fare의 합성어.

entries.sense_en: to go back over the steps or stages of something in order

synonyms.nuance: Follow something to its origin, not necessarily step by step.
Everyday phrase; review something again.

entries.sense_en: a paved road or footway (an old use of the word)

synonyms.nuance: Paved surface; British for a sidewalk.
The part of a street for vehicles.

entries.tip_ko: 오늘날 causeway는 주로 물이나 습지 위로 높게 쌓은 '둑길'을 뜻한다.

entries.sense_en: silent and bad-tempered because you are annoyed

synonyms.nuance: Mood changes easily; not always tied to one event.
Complaining and irritable; louder than sulky.
Darker and more lasting than sulky; angry and silent.

entries.sense_en: as a kind of; for the purpose of

synonyms.nuance: More neutral explanation of what something is.
Formal; something like or of the type of.
synonyms.example: in the nature of a test

entries.tip_ko: '~를 경유하여'(via)의 뜻도 있으니 문맥으로 구분.

entries.sense_en: a long, angry speech or piece of writing attacking someone

synonyms.nuance: Angry talk, often loud and disorganized.
Formal; a bitter attack in speech or writing.
Short and sudden; a tirade lasts longer.

entries.sense_en: a loud, sharp cry, often from fear or pain

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a loud cry of fear.
Harsh and unpleasant, also for machines or birds.
Loud shout, not always fear.

entries.sense_en: a heavy iron bar used to force things open

synonyms.nuance: Modern tool name; smaller and flatter.
Any bar used to lift or move things, not necessarily to break in.

entries.sense_en: a French police officer who is part of the armed forces

synonyms.nuance: General term; a gendarme is a specifically French kind.
British rank of ordinary police officer.

entries.tip_ko: '장다름'에 가깝게 읽는 프랑스어.

entries.sense_en: a hollow mark pressed into a surface

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; a hollow left by a blow.
A mark left by pressing something on a surface.

entries.sense_en: to damage a body badly by cutting or tearing off parts

synonyms.nuance: Spoil the appearance, especially of the face.
Injure so that a part of the body no longer works.
Crush or tear something into a shapeless mess.

entries.sense_en: a piece of evidence that helps solve a mystery

synonyms.nuance: The modern spelling of the same word.
A piece of information pointing to where to look next.
A small sign, often given on purpose.

entries.tip_ko: clue의 옛 철자. 발음도 같다.

entries.sense_en: to become known; to come out as a fact

synonyms.nuance: Come to light gradually.
Idiom; a hidden fact is discovered.
Modern loose use, but originally it meant 'become known'.

entries.tip_ko: 요즘은 '일어나다(happen)'의 뜻으로도 쓰이나 원래는 '드러나다'.

entries.sense_en: to state something formally as a witness under oath

synonyms.nuance: Give evidence in court; the everyday legal word.
Say clearly; no legal oath needed.
Promise under oath that something is true.

entries.tip_ko: '(왕을) 폐위시키다'라는 뜻도 있지만 여기서는 '증언하다'.

entries.sense_en: to save money for future use

synonyms.nuance: Keep something separate for later use.
Everyday phrase for collecting money bit by bit.

entries.sense_en: regularly doing something

synonyms.nuance: Used to something; more formal.
Everyday and shorter; can also mean past habit.

entries.tip_ko: of 뒤에는 동사 -ing가 온다.

entries.sense_en: to succeed in getting inside a building

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday phrase.
Formal, often used by police and news reports.

entries.sense_en: deep, rough and unfriendly-sounding (of a voice)

synonyms.nuance: Rough because of a sore throat or shouting, not attitude.
Short and rude in words, not about the sound.
Unpleasantly rough; can describe sound or treatment.

entries.sense_en: to support another person's statement by giving matching evidence

synonyms.nuance: Say something is true; the common everyday word.
Informal; support someone's account.
Formal; provide solid proof.

entries.sense_en: slightly open (of a door or window)

synonyms.nuance: Open about half way; ajar is only a little.
General; may be fully open.

entries.tip_ko: 형용사이며 명사 앞에 오지 않는다: The door was ajar.

entries.sense_en: a small room just under the roof of a house

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; used for storage or a room.
Open space under the roof, often converted for living.

entries.sense_en: to argue with someone in order to warn them or change their mind

synonyms.nuance: Almost the same; formal protest and complaint.
Say you disagree; broader and more common.
Give reasons against; may be angry, without any warning tone.

entries.sense_en: bluish-grey, the colour of a bad bruise

synonyms.nuance: Changed from its normal colour; general.
Informal; badly bruised.

entries.tip_ko: '몹시 화난'(livid with rage)이라는 뜻도 있으나 여기서는 멍든 색.

entries.sense_en: to stick out from a surface

synonyms.nuance: Everyday phrasal verb.
Swell outward in a round shape.
Extend sharply out, like a cliff or chin.

entries.sense_en: blunt, not sharp (of a weapon)

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for something without a sharp edge.
A blade that has lost its edge.

entries.tip_ko: 사람에게 쓰면 '둔감한, 이해가 느린'이라는 뜻이 된다. 각도의 '둔각'도 obtuse.

entries.sense_en: to confuse someone by being hard to understand
entries.sense_ko: 어리둥절하게 하다, 갈피를 못 잡게 하다

synonyms.nuance: Make someone think hard; lighter than perplex.
Stronger; completely unable to explain.
Confuse so that one feels lost.

entries.sense_en: to praise very highly

synonyms.nuance: General word; extol is stronger and more formal.
Formal, literary; public praise.
Make something seem wonderful, often religious.

entries.sense_en: great depth of thought; here, thinking too deeply

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for deep thought or feeling.
Strength of concentration or feeling.

entries.sense_en: the sky, seen as a great arch above the earth

synonyms.nuance: Poetic or religious word for the sky.
The plain everyday word.

entries.sense_en: confused and unable to find the right track (like hunting dogs that have lost the scent)

synonyms.nuance: Not knowing what to do or say; not about blame.
Completely confused by a puzzle.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서는 '잘못한'이 아니라 사냥개가 냄새 자취를 놓친 데서 나온 '갈피를 못 잡는' 뜻.

entries.sense_en: a way out of a place

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word, both the door and the act of leaving.
Plain, informal.

entries.tip_ko: 반대말은 ingress(들어가는 길).

entries.sense_en: hard to understand because it is deep or complicated

synonyms.nuance: Unclear or little known; not necessarily deep.
Deliberately mysterious in meaning.
Has many parts; not always hard to grasp.

entries.tip_ko: obscure보다 격식적인 말로, 주로 이론·학문·논증처럼 깊이 때문에 어려운 것에 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: to show or suggest that someone is involved in a crime

synonyms.nuance: Have a part in something; not always a crime.
Make someone look guilty by evidence.
Get someone caught up in trouble.

entries.sense_en: speech to oneself, as if nobody else is listening

synonyms.nuance: One person speaking at length, possibly to others.
Modern word for talking to yourself.

entries.sense_en: having knowledge of something; aware

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; knowing something exists.
Familiar with a subject through experience.
Having been told the facts.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 cognizant of + 명사로 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: a person or animal that lives in a particular place

synonyms.nuance: Neutral word for a resident.
Someone officially living somewhere.

entries.sense_en: to cause a feeling or situation to begin

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word.
Suggests something grows over time, usually bad.
Produce, for energy, ideas or feelings.

entries.tip_ko: generate와 같은 어원(라틴어 generare, '낳다')에서 왔다. 주로 감정·분위기를 목적어로 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: doing more than is needed or required

synonyms.nuance: Informal; far more effort than needed.
A too great amount of something.

entries.modern: "a matter of supererogation" → "more than was necessary"
entries.tip_ko: 매우 드문 격식적 단어. a matter of supererogation = 굳이 할 필요 없는 일.

entries.sense_en: a window; strictly, one that opens on hinges like a door

synonyms.nuance: The general everyday word.
The sliding frame that holds the glass in a window that moves up and down.

entries.tip_ko: 이 장면의 창은 위아래로 여는 내리닫이창(sash)이므로, 여기서 casement는 그냥 '창문'을 뜻하는 문어적 표현이다.

entries.sense_en: the long straight body of a nail or tool

synonyms.nuance: Long straight part of a tool, arrow or spear.
Thin main part of a plant or glass.

entries.tip_ko: 사람의 '정강이'(leg)를 뜻하기도 한다.

entries.sense_en: the ability to move quickly and lightly

synonyms.nuance: Light, quick, clever movement of hands or feet.
Skill in using the hands.
Ability to bend easily; not speed.

entries.sense_en: to prove that your argument is true

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; show that something is right.
Gather evidence step by step, especially in law.

entries.sense_en: the act or way of entering a place

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a door or the act of entering.
The right or way to get to something.

entries.sense_en: to load someone with something heavy or awkward that slows them

synonyms.nuance: Load with a heavy weight, also with worries.
Make movement or progress difficult.
Everyday phrase; make heavy.

entries.sense_en: to keep changing your mind; to be unable to decide

synonyms.nuance: Shake in one's decision; lighter and more common.
Pause before acting; not changing back and forth.
Informal; take too long to choose.

entries.sense_en: morally very bad or evil

synonyms.nuance: Deliberately bad; everyday word for evil.
Made bad by power or money.
Turned from what is normal, often sexually; a stronger and darker word.

entries.sense_en: a small bunch of hairs growing or held together

synonyms.nuance: Thin, light, small bit of hair or smoke.
A curl or bunch of hair on the head.
A thick lump of things together.

entries.sense_en: yellowish-brown in colour, like a lion's coat

synonyms.nuance: Plain description without literary tone.
Warmer; used for food and hair too.

entries.sense_en: a protest that tries to stop someone from doing something

synonyms.nuance: General expression of disagreement.
A statement that one disagrees.
Blame for something already done.

entries.sense_en: not attractive or pleasant to look at

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word about looks.
Informal; makes people dislike you at first sight.

entries.tip_ko: 'not altogether unprepossessing'은 이중 부정으로 '아주 비호감은 아닌, 어느 정도 호감이 가는'이라는 뜻.

entries.sense_en: a short thick stick used as a weapon

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a heavy stick.
Short stick carried by police.
General; may be light or for walking.

entries.sense_en: the keeping and feeding of horses for a fee; a livery stable boards animals or rents out horses
entries.sense_ko: (돈을 받고) 말을 맡아 기르거나 빌려주는 일; livery stable = 삯마구간

synonyms.nuance: A building for horses in general, with no idea of payment.
Paying to have an animal housed and fed; the modern word, used for kennels too.

entries.tip_ko: '(하인의) 제복'이라는 뜻도 있지만 여기서는 livery stable의 livery.

entries.sense_en: deserving blame for a wrong act

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; did a wrong.
Deserving criticism, not necessarily legal guilt.
In charge of or the cause of; neutral.

entries.sense_en: to keep someone or something away from other people

synonyms.nuance: Set apart, often for safety or illness.
Keep out of sight; no idea of privacy.
Everyday phrase; lock or keep in a private place.

entries.sense_en: a lively, playful outing or party

synonyms.nuance: A short wild period of drinking, spending, or fun.
Playful, noisy fun, especially by children.
Noisy merrymaking and drinking.

entries.sense_en: not knowing what to do or say

synonyms.nuance: Confused by something hard to understand.
Informal; helpless or confused.

entries.tip_ko: at a loss for words = 말문이 막힌.

entries.sense_en: to cover with soap foam, as before shaving

synonyms.nuance: Everyday phrase; cover with soap.
Produce many small bubbles.

entries.sense_en: to make lively movements of the hands and arms

synonyms.nuance: A single meaningful move of the hand.
Move the hand back and forth to signal.
Signal by a hand movement to tell someone to act.

entries.sense_en: to climb using both hands and feet, in a rough way

synonyms.nuance: Move quickly and awkwardly over rough ground.
General; can be smooth and easy.
Climb to the top of something high.

entries.tip_ko: b는 발음한다: '클램버'.

entries.sense_en: to faint from shock or strong feeling

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word for passing out.
Informal; lose consciousness.
synonyms.example: pass out at the sight of blood

synonyms.nuance: Fall down suddenly, not always unconscious.

entries.sense_en: a wild, uncontrolled state of rage or excitement

synonyms.nuance: Intense anger.
Uncontrolled emotion, often in a group.
Violent anger, without the idea of frantic activity.

entries.tip_ko: phrenzy는 frenzy의 옛 철자.

entries.sense_en: a sharp curved claw, especially of a bird of prey

synonyms.nuance: General word for a sharp nail on any animal's foot.
On humans or animals; not always sharp.

entries.sense_en: to throw with great force

synonyms.nuance: Throw carelessly and quickly.

synonyms.nuance: Throw lightly or casually.
The everyday word, no force implied.

entries.sense_en: filled with shock and horror

synonyms.nuance: Very shocked by something terrible.
Shocked and disgusted, moral outrage.
General surprise, milder than aghast.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 be aghast (at) 형태의 서술적 형용사.

entries.sense_en: anxious care or concern for someone or something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for caring worry.
General attention and protection.
Careful attention to someone's needs.

entries.sense_en: extremely cruel or evil, like a devil

synonyms.nuance: Like a devil; can also be playful.
Evil and clever; also used loosely for 'terrible'.
Everyday word for bad or evil.

entries.sense_en: inclined or glad to do something; here, unable to resist doing it

synonyms.nuance: Ready to do something; neutral.
Feeling a tendency to do something.

entries.tip_ko: feign(~인 체하다)과 발음이 같다. 고어로, be fain to 형태로 쓰인다.
